title: Wilder Dreams
meta_description: Wilder Dreams is a 6 bedroom, 5 bath GULF FRONT home in the private gated community of Waters Edge. This small gated community South of 30A is located just steps from Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Seacrest Beach.
description_expanded: DescriptionNestled within the aptly named Waters Edge community in Seacrest Beach, Wilder Dreams is a sprawling six-bedroom estate with space for everyone. Your group will love the proximity to the bright blue ocean waters and gentle sea breezes. Plus, the oceanfront swimming pool and fire pit are the ideal spots to relax with cocktails and conversation at the end of each day. You can use the six provided bicycles to peddle into Rosemary Beach or Alys Beach for an afternoon lunch or a leisurely dinner.The main great room is located on the second level, allowing for gorgeous natural light and stunning panoramic views. The interior of the space has been thoughtfully drenched in soothing neutrals and creams, a color scheme that allows the breathtaking turquoise of the ocean to take center stage. Slipcovered sofas face an 85" FRAME TV, while glass doors lead outside onto the exquisite Gulf-front terrace.An expansive formal dining table is illuminated by beaded chandeliers and leads directly into the gourmet-style kitchen. There’s a large island with plenty of extra seating, plus bright white cabinets surrounding the full suite of premier appliances, including a smooth top induction range, a double wall oven, and a massive refrigerator.The first bedroom is located on this main level and includes a bedroom with a queen-sized bed. Also on the lower level, the second bedroom has a luxe king-size bed and an ensuite bathroom. Finishing out the first floor, the third and fourth bedrooms have built-in bunks that house a twin-over-queen-size bed and a trundle. The two bunk rooms share a Jack and Jill bathroom between them. You will find a fifth room on the second level holding a queen-sized bed.Climb the stairs to the top floor, where the ultra-private and final primary bedroom suite awaits. With an upholstered king-size bed, HDTV, and a private balcony that overlooks the Gulf, this space is like a secluded sanctuary. This room also includes a sitting area, and the spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with walk-in shower.Although Wilder Dreams was designed for complete comfort in the interior, chances are you may want to spend the majority of your time outdoors. With a sparkling swimming pool to gather around— plus a gas grill for preparing fresh seafood or burgers— the patio at Wilder Dreams is the place where everyone lingers while listening to the sound of the nearby waves against the shore.Home Highlights* Gulf Front* Private Pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Located in a private gated community* Steps from Rosemary and Alys Beach* 6 bicycles included* Parking for 6 vehicles in single lane drive* Clean Bedding ProgramFirst Floor (Sleeps 12)Private heated poolGas grill and outdoor dining areaBedroom with a queen-size bed w/shared bathroom with shower/tub combo (Sleeps 2) Bunk room with a twin-over-queen-size bunk and a twin trundle w/ensuite bathroom w/shower only (jack/jill) (Sleeps 4)Second bunk room with a twin-over-queen-size bunk and a twin trundle w/ensuite bathroom w/shower only ( (jack/jill)) (Sleeps 4)Bedroom suite with a king-size bed w/ensuite bathroom w/shower only (Sleeps 2)Second Floor (Sleeps 2)Great room with living areaOutdoor terrace with gulf viewDining areaGourmet kitchenBedroom suite with a queen-sized bed and ensuite bathroom w/ shower only (Sleeps 2)Third Floor (Sleeps 2)Private primary bedroom sanctuary w/ living area, balcony w/ gulf views, and a king-size bed (Sleeps 2)Ensuite bathroom w/ walk-in shower.*During peak seasons of Spring Break & Summer, this property is rented on a 7-night basis from Saturday to Saturday.*
